title: 第五章 末等宫奴第六章 朝堂风云
slug: 根骨被毁我逆袭成准帝
lines: 她从床上坐起来，发现发髻上插的木簪还在，嘴巴里有淡淡的药味，后背已经不怎么痛了，显然七根金钉钉出的伤口被人处理过了，身上也换了一身崭新的青色长裙，只是身体虚弱的厉害，胳膊软腿软。
“三公主，你醒了。”鸣秀看到孟婵玥醒了，忙将温在一旁的燕窝粥端过来：“这燕窝粥还热着，我来喂你。”
孟婵玥腹中空空，饿得厉害，也不推辞，直接在鸣秀的侍候下吃了一大碗燕窝粥。
鸣秀将空碗递给候在暖阁外的宫女，然后看着面容憔悴苍白却更为精致美貌的孟婵玥，幽幽说道：“三公主，庄圣王说，若是你以后乖巧听话，不再想着与他作对，他就留你住在这暖阁里，享受后宫宫妃的待遇……”
孟婵玥闻言，心中大怒，气得一把捶断了雕花木床边的木栏杆。
“我与庄拓不死不休！”
见孟婵玥如此，鸣秀面色一变，冷冷道：“果然不识抬举，不过一个根骨被毁的废人，竟然对庄圣王不敬。”
“既然你不想成为这暖阁的主人，那么就去做观星殿最末等的宫奴吧！”
“今后，有你后悔的时候！”
说完，一把将孟婵玥从床上拽下来，拉着她走出后殿暖阁，来到末等宫奴住的矮房处。
“黍管事，这是新来的宫奴婵玥，多给她分配些活来做。”
鸣秀朗声喊了一句，松开孟婵玥的手。
一个身材矮瘦，细眉细眼，留着八字胡的青衣宫侍听到动静，从一间矮房里走出来。他一脸谄媚地走到鸣秀身旁，腰几乎弯成直角。
“鸣秀姑姑，你放心，来到我这里的宫奴，没有一个不好好干活的。”
说完，朝鸣秀身旁的孟婵玥看了一眼。这一眼，让他浑身发酥，整个人怔在原地。
迎上黍管事浑浊黏腻的目光，孟婵玥只觉得胃中有些作呕。她垂下眼眸，心中暗暗警惕。
这一日的大昭朝堂比往日更热闹些，鎏金香炉里的龙涎香袅袅升起，却压不住满殿的窃窃私语。文武百官垂着手站在班列中，眼角余光却不住地往殿首瞟，个个脸上都掩不住八卦的神色。只因今日朝堂上的两位核心人物，太子萧世安与庄圣王两人的脖子上竟都缠着雪白的纱布。
太子的伤在左侧颈间，纱布只轻轻绕了两圈。可庄圣王就不同了，就伤在咽喉处，脖颈上的纱布层层叠叠，边缘还洇出了新的血渍。
“陛下驾到……”
随着内侍尖细的唱喏，昭武帝萧靖渊从殿外走来，他坐上龙椅，一眼就扫到了阶下二人，眉头瞬间拧成了疙瘩。
“世安，庄拓，你们俩的脖子是怎么回事？”
萧世安率先出列，声音沉稳，嘴角微微勾起：“儿臣昨夜在东宫散步，不想惊到了一只狸猫，被她挠了一爪子。”
他话音刚落，庄圣王也躬身行礼，眼中闪过幽光：“回陛下，一点小伤而已。”
昭武帝闻言，不由气笑了。
content_en:
She sat up from the bed and found that the wooden hairpin in her bun was still there. There was a faint smell of medicine in her mouth, and her back no longer hurt. It was obvious that the wounds caused by the seven golden nails had been treated. She had also put on a brand new blue dress, but her body was very weak, her arms and legs were weak.
"Third Princess, you're awake." Mingxiu saw that Meng Chanyue was awake and hurriedly brought over the warm bird's nest porridge: "This bird's nest porridge is still hot, let me feed you."
Meng Chanyue had an empty belly and was very hungry. She didn't refuse and ate a large bowl of bird's nest porridge directly under Mingxiu's wait.
Mingxiu handed the empty bowl to the maid waiting outside the Nuan Pavilion, then looked at Meng Chanyue, who was haggard and pale but more delicate and beautiful, and said quietly: "Third princess, King Zhuang Sheng said that if you are obedient and obedient in the future and no longer think about going against him, he will let you live in the Nuan Pavilion and enjoy the treatment of a concubine in the harem..."
When Meng Chanyue heard this, she was so angry that she smashed the wooden railing beside the carved wooden bed.
"Zhuang Tuo and I will fight until death!"
Seeing Meng Chanyue like this, Mingxiu's expression changed and she said coldly: "Sure enough, I don't know how to appreciate him, but a cripple with his bones destroyed is disrespectful to King Zhuang Sheng."
"Since you don't want to be the master of Nuan Pavilion, then become the lowest slave in the Star Gazing Hall!"
"There will be times when you regret it from now on!"
After saying that, he pulled Meng Chanyue off the bed, pulled her out of the back hall and the low room where the last-class slaves lived.
"Manager Mao, this is the new palace slave Chan Yue. Give her more work to do."
Ming Xiu shouted loudly and let go of Meng Chanyue's hand.
A short and thin palace attendant in Tsing Yi with thin eyebrows and mustache heard the noise and walked out of a short room. He walked up to Mingxiu with a flattering look on his face, his waist almost bent at a right angle.
"Aunt Mingxiu, don't worry, none of the palace slaves who come to my place will not work well."
After saying that, he glanced at Meng Chanyue next to Mingxiu. This sight made him tremble all over, and he was stunned in place.
Facing the turbid and sticky eyes of the millet manager, Meng Chanyue felt a little sick in her stomach. She lowered her eyes, secretly wary in her heart.
On this day, the Jokhang Hall was more lively than usual. The ambergris in the gilded incense burner curled up, but it could not suppress the whispers in the hall. The civil and military officials stood in the train with their hands hanging down, but they kept glancing towards the head of the palace from the corner of their eyes, and they couldn't hide the gossipy look on their faces. Just because the two core figures in the court today, Prince Xiao Shian and King Zhuang Sheng, both had snow-white gauze wrapped around their necks.
The prince's injury was on the left side of his neck, and the gauze was only lightly wrapped twice. But King Zhuang Sheng was different. The injury was in his throat. There were layers of gauze on his neck, and there were new blood stains on the edges.
"Your Majesty has arrived..."
As the chamberlain sang in a high-pitched voice, Emperor Zhaowu Xiao Jingyuan came from outside the palace. He sat on the dragon chair and glanced at the two people below the steps. His brows instantly knitted into knots.
"Shi'an, Zhuang Tuo, what's wrong with your necks?"
Xiao Shi'an was the first to come out, his voice was calm, and the corners of his mouth were slightly raised: "My son was walking in the East Palace last night. I didn't want to startle a civet cat and get scratched by her."
As soon as he finished speaking, King Zhuang Sheng also bowed and saluted, a faint light flashed in his eyes: "Your Majesty, it's just a minor injury."
Emperor Zhaowu couldn't help laughing when he heard this.
